scope: Three isolated native playback queue runs for a known-version-unavailable entry followed by a duplicate local recording occurrence.
playbackNoticeReview: A separate private live capture showed the unavailable reason and an Open catalog action while the following local occurrence was playing. The existing notice expires after about 5.5 seconds; a later capture after expiry correctly showed no notice.
limitations: These are native playback runs, not the default WebView path; verify the same case in WebView before closing Sasa playback acceptance.
Although each run used a fresh profile, provider and preparation state were not controlled. Transition times are not cold-start measurements or p95 data.
Successful advancement to a duplicate local occurrence does not prove the unavailable candidate was the correct recording version.
The separate album playback issue remains open.
The report contains no track IDs, account identifiers, URLs, credentials or private screenshots.
